versions.content: If the configuration item SecOCGeneral/SecOCPropagateOnlyFinalVerificationStatus is set to TRUE , then only the final status shall be reported. If this item is set to FALSE , then each individual verification status (the final one as well as all previous failed ones) shall be reported according to SWS_SecOC_00048 and SWS_SecOC_00271 .
